description: Defines the Drupal content block entity class 'BlockContent', including its properties, methods, and entity type annotations, for managing reusable content blocks within Drupal.

classes.name: BlockContent
classes.description: Drupal entity class representing a reusable content block, with properties and methods for managing block data, revisions, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: createDuplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the block content entity, resetting revision and ID.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the theme associated with the block.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the theme associated with the block.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Performs actions after saving, including cache invalidation if reusable.

methods.name: preDelete
methods.description: Prepares entities for deletion, deleting instances.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Performs actions after deletion, invalidating cache if necessary.

methods.name: getInstances
methods.description: Loads block instances associated with this content block.

methods.name: preSaveRevision
methods.description: Prepares revision data before saving, preserving revision log if not provided.

methods.name: baseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines base fields for the entity, including ID, UUID, revision, language, type, info, change time, and reusability.

methods.name: setInfo
methods.description: Sets the description info for the block.

methods.name: isReusable
methods.description: Checks if the block is marked as reusable.

methods.name: invalidateBlockPluginCache
methods.description: Invalidates the block plugin cache to reflect changes.
